text:
zoe: Hey team — customer ACMECorp reports a 403 when any member tries to open Project > Settings after yesterday's IdP group rename. They can view the project but all action buttons are greyed out and API calls to /v1/projects/:id/settings return 403. Repro steps below.
julia: Thanks Zoe — can you paste the exact API error and a request ID? Also which org/project IDs?
zoe: Request ID: req_0a9c3f2b. Org: org-3782, Project: proj-1221. Error body: {"error":"permission_denied","message":"user missing project.write"}
I repro'd in UI: logged in as user joe@acme, click Settings -> 403 modal.
mike: @eng-oncall FYI — this smells like SCIM/group mapping rename causing role membership to be orphaned. ACME said they renamed Okta group from "acme-engineering" -> "acme-eng-2026" last night.
eng-oncall: I'm pulling audit logs now. Can you confirm whether the affected users still show as members of the project in console->members (they might be orphaned due to group external_id mismatch)?
zoe: Console shows them as members but role column is blank for the group membership rows. Individual users added directly still have roles.
eng-oncall: That matches an edge case: when SCIM group externalId changes, our sync keeps group as a member record but loses linked role bindings. Workaround: re-sync or re-add the group mapping in IdP, or add role back via API.
julia: Can you try a quick repro: curl as org admin to our admin API to list rolebindings:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_KEY" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/org-3782/projects/proj-1221/rolebindings"
```
and paste response.
mike: If rolebindings show the group id with an empty role object that's the bug. We can patch rolebinding with PUT /rolebindings/:rbid { role: "project.admin" } until sync fix.
audit-bot: [audit] 2026-02-16T03:12:08Z SCIM group update: externalId changed: "acme-engineering" -> "acme-eng-2026" (actor: acme-okta-svc)
eng-oncall: Ok confirmed by audit. I'm going to escalate to infra-sync team to run targeted rehydrate for org-3782. ETA ~45m. In the meantime, support pre-approved manual fix: add rolebinding via admin patch. Julia, can you share the admin curl example with the customer?
julia: Sent the example and a step-by-step: 1) backup rolebindings, 2) patch the group binding with role, 3) confirm access. If they prefer we can do a one-off fix on our side with explicit consent.
zoe: Customer accepted one-off fix. Please include change records and which sysops touch it. Also can we add a guard to detect empty-role group bindings during SCIM sync? That's a regression risk.
eng-oncall: Noted — will create a ticket for a sync validation that rejects empty-role group bindings and add alerting. I'll post updates in this thread once the rehydrate completes. :thumbsup:
